name: IVU Traffic Technologies AG
summary: IVU Traffic Technologies AG, together with its subsidiaries, develops, installs, maintains, and operates integrated IT solutions for buses and trains worldwide. The company offers IVU.suite, which provides service and resource planning, resource dispatching, fleet management, ticketing and on-board devices, information and analytics, and controlling services. It also provides IVU.consult consulting services; IVU.solutions that offer customized IT solutions; IVU.integration, which connects peripheral systems; IVU.xpress implementation process services; IVU.cloud, which enables full technical operations management for IVU.suite; and IVU.service that provides support services.
